en.headline: Van driver arrested after hitting 73-year-old woman at Pok Fu Lam crossing
en.dek: Police said the woman was unconscious when taken to Queen Mary Hospital after the vehicle struck her while turning onto Chi Fu Road around 8am.
body: Police arrested a 36-year-old van driver on suspicion of dangerous driving causing grievous bodily harm after his vehicle struck a 73-year-old woman at a pedestrian crossing in Pok Fu Lam on Monday morning.

The incident occurred around 8am when the van, which had just finished unloading at Chi Fu Landmark, turned right onto Chi Fu Road. The woman, surnamed Fong, was crossing from the left side of the vehicle and was thrown to the ground. She was unconscious when paramedics arrived and was taken to Queen Mary Hospital.
The driver, surnamed Ho, was detained for investigation. Police said no other injuries were reported.

zh.headline: 薄扶林客貨車撞倒73歲婦人 司機涉危駕被捕
zh.dek: 警方指婦人在置富道行人過路線被撞後不省人事，送瑪麗醫院救治；事件約於上午8時發生。
body: 警方周一早上拘捕一名36歲客貨車司機，涉嫌危險駕駛引致他人身體嚴重傷害，其車輚在薄扶林行人過路線撞倒一名73歲婦人。
事件約於上午8時發生，客貨車剛在置富都會卸貨後右轉入置富道。婦人方姓，從車輚左側橫過馬路時被撞倒在地。救護員到場時她已不省人事，送往瑪麗醫院。
司機何姓被扣留調查。警方表示事件中沒有其他受傷報告。
